mentions.name: HALUD YOUR HORSES
mentions.description: A containerized development workflow that reduces exposure to supply-chain attacks in the JavaScript and Node.js ecosystem. Each project runs inside an isolated container with its own node_modules volume, so nothing from npm executes directly on the host machine. The tools are simple shell scripts that create, enter, and fork project-specific development images.
mentions.problem: Reduces exposure to supply-chain attacks in the JavaScript and Node.js ecosystem.
